name: Cursor Agent (Local)
description: Drives the cursor-agent CLI directly on your own machine, aimed at throwaway experiments and shop-floor command-line work. Assumes cloud agents remain in charge of anything touching GitHub pull requests, so treat this as the local sandbox rather than the main pipeline.
